method: Whisk yolk and mustard.
Whisk in oil very gradually until emulsified.
Season with lemon and salt.
Stir the mayonnaise and sriracha together until the colour is completely even.
Mix in the lime juice, taste, and add a little more lime if it needs brightness.
Transfer to a clean covered container and refrigerate until needed.
make.storage: Keep refrigerated in a clean covered container and use within the safe life of the mayonnaise used.

method: Mix until smooth; loosen with a teaspoon of water if needed.
Slice the onion as thinly and evenly as possible and pack it into a clean container.
Stir the vinegar, water, sugar and salt together until the sugar and salt have dissolved.
Pour the pickling liquid over the onion and press the slices down so they are coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before using.
make.storage: Keep refrigerated in a clean covered container.

method: Measure all of the spices into a small bowl.
Mix thoroughly until the colour is even and there are no clumps.
Transfer to a dry airtight container and label it.
make.storage: Store airtight in a cool, dry cupboard.

buy.item: chicken stock cubes or fresh stock

method: Put the carcass, vegetables and any suitable herb stalks into a large saucepan or stock pot.
Add enough cold water to just cover the contents and bring slowly to a gentle simmer.
Keep at a gentle simmer rather than a hard boil for about 1 1/2-2 hours, skimming the surface if necessary.
Strain through a fine sieve, discard the solids, and cool the stock promptly.
Refrigerate the amount needed soon and freeze the remainder in useful measured portions.
make.storage: Cool promptly. Refrigerate only for short-term use; freeze portions not needed soon.

method: Blend or pound ingredients to a coarse sauce and season.
Mix the flour, yeast and salt, keeping the salt from sitting directly on the yeast before mixing.
Add the water and 20ml olive oil and mix to a sticky dough; knead or stretch until smoother and elastic.
Cover and leave until roughly doubled in size.
Transfer to a well-oiled baking tin, gently stretch towards the corners and leave until visibly puffed.
Heat the oven to 220C / 200C fan. Dimple the dough with oiled fingertips and drizzle over the remaining oil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until deeply golden on top and crisp around the edges, then cool on a rack.
make.storage: Keep the amount needed soon; slice and freeze surplus once completely cool.

method: Tip the flour onto the work surface and make a wide well in the centre.
Crack in the eggs and beat them with a fork, gradually drawing flour in from the sides.
Bring the dough together and knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Wrap tightly and rest at room temperature for 30 minutes before rolling.
Divide according to the week's plan, then roll and cut or shape as required.
make.storage: Use promptly or freeze suitable shaped pasta in portions.
